recipe.label: OECD ICIO · Extended
recipe.ghg_method: No emissions extension in this reading.
recipe.license_note: OECD ICIO-derived indicators; cite OECD and the selected release.
recipe.value_added_note: The published VA row, summed over the selected industries.
recipe.gdp_note: Value added at basic prices + net product taxes on intermediate and final uses. Current prices.
recipe.attribution: OECD ICIO, Extended, 2019. Indicators calculated with MARIO; cite OECD.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied. OECD HFCE already includes NPISH for some economies, so separate household-only comparisons are not offered.
notes.value_added_footprint: Value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet the selected final demand. Consumer columns are retained throughout; production-origin totals are independently reconciled.
